description: CodeMode plan composition benchmark: one-plan execution vs equivalent sequences of direct calls
methodology: Same TokenZeroEngine instance, same tokenizer (count_tokens), same cache. Plan execution dispatches all ops in one call; direct calls execute each op separately. Visible tokens include return-value framing for plans.

workloads.description: Read a file, grep for pattern, filter results, compact output
Run multiple shell commands and aggregate results in one plan
Pipe: read then compact then expand, demonstrating zero-roundtrip chaining
Explore project structure: tree + glob + targeted reads in one plan
